C1423.title: Horizen (ZenCash) Suffers 51% Attack with Over $500K in Losses
C1423.summary: On June 2, 2018, the privacy coin Horizen (formerly ZenCash) suffered a 51% attack. The attacker rented hash power to gain majority control and double-spent approximately 23,000 ZEN, resulting in losses of about $550,000. The ZenCash team subsequently required exchanges to increase confirmations and developed a delayed-function mechanism to penalize malicious miners.
